The days left until your life expectancy. Tap the chips below to switch to weeks, months or years. Set the default in Settings.

Tap once to pet it, tap twice to open its page, and hold to hear it sing. Family and pet stones work the same way.
The left end is the day you were born, the right end your life expectancy. Haru sits where you are now and moves a little to the right each year.
